title: LANGUAGE COMPREHENSION AND LITERACY IN THE ELEMENTARY CLASSROOM
description: Focuses on the connection between language comprehension and successful literacy skills, including teaching vocabulary and reading comprehension routines, capitalizing on background knowledge, and promoting culturally and linguistically sustaining practices.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: ED 449.
A minimum grade of C is required in ED 449.

Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Elementary Education (A038).
meeting_html: MW 8:30am-9:50am in FURM 105 - Joyce Collin Furman Hall 105 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
